items.claim: Reconnect drops the caller's `frame` when it places the fixed end
items.note: The same omission was in `createEdgeEnds` (`edgeEndLayer.ts`), so the edge-end handles and the routes they read were also off the frame. Fixed in the same commit.

items.claim: Stencil rows are measured at 16px but drawn at `font`
items.note: `diagramScene`'s measure wrapper moved into a shared `measureInFace` (`faceMeasure.ts`), and the stencil path now uses it too.

items.claim: Remove waypoint ignores locked and hidden edges and throws on commit
items.note: It now applies the same `offersPorts` and `isLocked` gate as the handle layer, on both the press path and the point path.

items.claim: Reset route is enabled with a locked edge selected and throws mid-batch
items.note: It now reports `ActionDisabledReason.Locked`, as `routerPlan` does, and `run` does nothing in that case.

items.claim: waypointFollower rewrites a locked connector, so the whole move is refused
`reorderTargetOf` hangs when cluster boxes hold each other through `dependsOn`
items.note: Before the fix the test hung until a 60 s timeout killed it.

items.claim: `createDiagramNodes` gives kind traits to edges, labels and lanes
items.note: A node whose own trait takes no ports now gets nothing from its kind. The docstring now says `{ ports: [] }` is how a node opts out.

items.claim: The outline polyline joins separate subpaths, so ports can land in the gap between pieces
items.note: A new export, `outlineRings`, returns one closed ring per subpath, and `rayHit` now accepts rings. `portsOnOutline` and `portsOf` cast against those rings. This change has two changesets: a `patch` fix, and a `minor` for the new API (`outlineRings`). Single-subpath shapes get the same `outlinePolyline` output as before.
